annotations.text:
binQad homepage redesign — same brand system as the live site (claret #750f3b/#8b1538, Poppins + Comfortaa wordmark, 16px card radii, #16202e footer).

What changed: hero is left-aligned and asymmetric instead of centred; the 12+/8/Dubai stats moved out of About into an overlapping trust bar; the seven differentiators lost their photos and became a varied numbered grid; the eight services became an icon-led 4-up grid; contact moved onto a claret band.

All copy, phone numbers and the address are lifted from the current site. No enquiry form was added — say the word if you want one.
Same page at 390px. All tap targets are 44px or larger; no fake status bar or keyboard chrome.
